verdict.rationale: Webhooks for verification lifecycle events are a fair axis for a KYC/KYB verification platform like AiPrise. The evidence pack never mentions webhooks, event callbacks, payload signing, or lifecycle states such as created, processing, verified, or requires-input. General references to APIs and hosted flows are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, verification lifecycle events arrive as signed webhooks — created, processing, verified, requires-input — so my system reacts to outcomes without polling
